teaser.en: Nobody needs to plant this amaranth: it simply turns up in the farm, and ends up in the pot with coconut milk.
teaser.sw: Hakuna haja ya kupanda mchicha huu: huota wenyewe shambani, na mwishowe huishia chunguni na tui la nazi.

summary.en: *Chiswenya* is a wild amaranth, a soft green herb that springs up in farms and gardens. Its leaves are a favourite everyday vegetable, cooked with coconut milk.
summary.sw: *Chiswenya* ni mchicha wa porini, mmea laini wa kijani unaoota wenyewe mashambani na bustanini. Majani yake ni mboga pendwa ya kila siku, hupikwa kwa tui la nazi.

about.en: *Chiswenya* is a soft, leafy herb with oval to diamond-shaped leaves on long stalks and small green flowers packed into spikes. It grows quickly and can be picked within weeks of springing up.
about.sw: *Chiswenya* ni mmea laini wenye majani mengi, yenye umbo la yai hadi la almasi juu ya vikonyo virefu, na maua madogo ya kijani yaliyosongamana kwenye vishada virefu. Hukua haraka na unaweza kuchumwa wiki chache tu baada ya kuota.

where.en: It comes up by itself as a weed in farms and gardens, and is also planted. After the rains it is easy to find on almost any cultivated plot.
where.sw: Huota wenyewe kama gugu mashambani na bustanini, na pia hupandwa. Baada ya mvua ni rahisi kuupata karibu katika kila shamba lililolimwa.

uses.en: The leaves are sauteed or cooked with coconut milk, as in *mchicha wa nazi*.
uses.sw: Majani yake hukaangwa au hupikwa kwa tui la nazi, kama katika *mchicha wa nazi*.

names.en: In Digo it is *chiswenya*. Mgombato applies the name to two species, *Amaranthus dubius* and *A. graecizans*, while Pakia uses it for *A. graecizans*. Digo also has broader words for greens: *mtsunga* for vegetables, especially amaranths, and *makaya* for greens or spinach. Swahili calls it *mchicha*. In English it is amaranth or wild amaranth.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo huitwa *chiswenya*. Mgombato inalitumia jina hili kwa spishi mbili, *Amaranthus dubius* na *A. graecizans*, ilhali Pakia inalitumia kwa *A. graecizans*. Kidigo pia kina maneno mapana zaidi ya mboga za majani: *mtsunga* kwa mboga, hasa michicha, na *makaya* kwa mboga za majani au spinachi. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mchicha*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *amaranth* au *wild amaranth*.

reason.en: Same genus; the tall amaranth green
reason.sw: Jenasi moja; mchicha mrefu wa majani

reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani inayoota bustanini

reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani ya porini kutoka pembezoni mwa shamba
